instructions: Record each text_rw line as public/audio/rw/<id>.mp3 (mono, ~64kbps). Mark reviewed true after native review.

phrases.text_en: How old is the patient, in months?
phrases.text_rw: Umurwayi afite imyaka ingahe, mu mezi?

phrases.text_en: This is a danger sign. Please say yes to confirm, or no if I misunderstood.
phrases.text_rw: Iki ni ikimenyetso cy'akaga. Vuga yego niba ari ukuri, cyangwa oya niba nabitumvise nabi.

phrases.text_en: Please confirm this recommendation on screen before you finish.
phrases.text_rw: Nyamuneka wemeze icyo cyifuzo kuri ekrani mbere yo kurangiza.

phrases.text_en: Convulsions or fits, yes or no?
phrases.text_rw: Gusetsa cyangwa fits, yego cyangwa oya?

phrases.text_en: Does the patient have fever?
phrases.text_rw: Umurwayi afite ubushyuhe?

phrases.text_en: How many days has the fever lasted?
phrases.text_rw: Ubushyuhe bwamaze iminsi ingahe?

phrases.text_en: Voice guided triage. I will ask each question. Answer clearly, then confirm what I heard.
phrases.text_rw: Gupima mu ijwi. Nzakubaza ibibazo. Subiza neza, hanyuma wemeze ibyo numvise.

phrases.text_en: Age in months drives infant referral rules. Use months for children under five.
phrases.text_rw: Imyaka mu mezi igena amategeko yo kohereza abana bato. Koresha amezi ku bana bari munsi y'imyaka itanu.

phrases.text_en: Convulsions are a danger sign, answer yes if the patient had fits or seizures.
phrases.text_rw: Gusetsa ni ikimenyetso cy'akaga, subiza yego niba umurwayi yagize fits cyangwa seizures.

phrases.text_en: Long fever with a negative test may still need referral per national rules.
phrases.text_rw: Ubushyuhe bw'iminsi myinshi n'ikizamini cyiza bishobora gusaba kohereza ukurikije amategeko.

phrases.text_en: Optional notes in Kinyarwanda or English. AI may suggest fields, you must verify before applying.
phrases.text_rw: Inyandiko z'ubushobozi mu Kinyarwanda cyangwa Icyongereza. AI ishobora gusaba ibice, ugomba kubigenzura mbere yo kubikoresha.

phrases.text_en: Yes if the patient is very weak, difficult to wake, or unconscious.
phrases.text_rw: Subiza yego niba umurwayi afite intege nke cyane, agorwa gukanguka, cyangwa ntabona.

phrases.text_en: Yes if breathing is fast, noisy, or the chest pulls in with each breath.
phrases.text_rw: Subiza yego niba aruhuka vuba, ijwi ryo guhumeka, cyangwa igifu kinjira mu guhumeka.

phrases.text_en: Sex is recorded for the patient record; it does not change the malaria decision alone.
phrases.text_rw: Igitsina cyandikwa mu dosiye; nticyihindura icyemezo cya malaria cyonyine.

phrases.text_en: Record the rapid diagnostic test result from the cassette. Invalid means the test failed, do not treat on that result alone.
phrases.text_rw: Andika igisubizo cy'ikizamini cy'umusaraba. Nticyemewe bisobanuye ko ikizamini cyanze, ntuvure ukurikije gusa icyo.

phrases.text_en: Measure axillary or rectal temperature. Very high fever with danger signs needs urgent referral.
phrases.text_rw: Pima ubushyuhe bw'umubiri. Ubushyuhe bwinshi hamwe n'ibimenyetso by'akaga bisaba kohereza vuba.

phrases.text_en: Yes if the patient cannot drink or breastfeed at all.
phrases.text_rw: Subiza yego niba umurwayi ntashobora kunywa cyangwa kuronsa na gato.

phrases.text_en: Yes if the patient vomits all food or fluids and cannot keep anything down.
phrases.text_rw: Subiza yego niba araruka byose kandi ntashobora kubika ibyo yariye cyangwa yanyoye.

phrases.text_en: Lethargy or unconsciousness, yes or no?
phrases.text_rw: Yacitse intege cyangwa ntabona, yego cyangwa oya?

phrases.text_rw: Imyaka mu mezi

phrases.text_en: Severe breathing difficulty?
phrases.text_rw: Agorwa cyane n'uruhuhu?

phrases.text_rw: Igicuri?

phrases.text_en: Days of fever
phrases.text_rw: Iminsi y'ubushyuhe

phrases.text_en: Lethargy or unconscious?

phrases.text_en: Unable to drink or feed?
phrases.text_rw: Ntashobora kunywa cyangwa kurya?

phrases.text_en: Vomiting everything?
phrases.text_rw: Araruka byose?

phrases.text_en: Prepare a referral handover and help the patient reach the health center.
phrases.text_rw: Tegeka kohereza umurwayi kandi umufashe kugera ku kigo nderabuzima.

phrases.text_en: Give home care advice, schedule follow-up, and confirm the decision before closing.
phrases.text_rw: Tanga inama zo kwita mu rugo, teganya gukurikirana, wemeze icyemezo mbere yo gufunga.

phrases.text_en: Refer urgently now. Stay with the patient if possible and call for transport help.
phrases.text_rw: Ohereza vuba. Guma hafi y'umurwayi niba bishoboka kandi hamagara ubufasha bwo gutwara.

phrases.text_en: Seek care quickly if danger signs appear or the child worsens.
phrases.text_rw: Shakira ubuvuzi vuba niba ibimenyetso by'akaga bihagaze cyangwa umwana agenda ababaye.

phrases.text_en: Test early when fever starts, do not wait many days.
phrases.text_rw: Kora ikizamini vuba ubushyuhe buhera, ntugere ute iminsi myinshi.

phrases.text_en: Reduce mosquito bites: cover arms and legs in the evening, clear standing water near homes.
phrases.text_rw: Gabanya ibitotsi by'inzige: ukinge intoki n'amaguru nimugoroba, kuraho amazi ahagaze hafi y'urugo.

phrases.text_en: Sleep under an insecticide-treated bed net every night.
phrases.text_rw: Rya munsi y'urutoki rw'ibisabwa buri joro.

phrases.text_rw: Icyifuzo: kuvura mu rugo hamwe no gukurikirana mu mudugudu.

phrases.text_en: Urgent recommendation: refer immediately to a health center.

phrases.text_rw: Dore impamvu icyifuzo cyakozwe, hashingiwe ku mategeko yabonetse.
